og.xlsx.prefix: Name of the downloaded file: origine_<mz>_da_<mz>; lowercase letters only, no accents.
og.heavier: «Δm from the candidate» cell; {dm} = mass difference.
og.lighter: «Δm from the candidate» cell; {dm} = mass difference.
og.leg.co: Legend of the origin plot; {mz} = m/z of a chosen co-eluting ion.
og.leg.ion: Legend of the origin plot; {mz} = m/z of the ion studied.
og.leg.par: Legend of the origin plot; {mz} = m/z of the parent.
og.lossHint: Tooltip on a table row; {dm} = mass difference from the candidate, {lost} = same difference rounded.
og.waitN: Seconds counter during the computation; {s} = seconds elapsed.
